tests.title: Channel and crossfader sweep
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check Xone:96 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all fader controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
